adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` is wrapped in a `try/catch` that only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` and then continues to `return { message: "Guests added" }`. This means email delivery failures are not surfaced to the caller and no error details are logged, while the UI will treat the operation as successful.
